Locality.gml:description: The site is a vacant plot that is generally flat. Bounded by vacant plots on all sides except south side. At the time of investigation, the site was unoccupied. No high voltage, electrical or telephone poles, sewer or water pipes were observed within the depth of the drilled boreholes.

DesignGroutMix.gml:name: MIX-A — Very Severe (Mg>1000) Design Mix

Remark.content: Per 70-TMSS-03 Rev.02 Table 8B, Very Severe (Mg>1000) exposure. Cement: Type I (C3A 8-14%) (SG=3.15); Fly Ash at 25% replacement of total binder by mass (SG=2.3). W/BM (max)=0.36; W/C=0.48. Min binding material=390 kg/m3 (cement + SCM). Max Cl in concrete=0.1%. Min compressive strength (f'c)=38 MPa. Air content assumed 2%. Specific gravities: cement=3.15, Fly Ash=2.3, sand=2.65, water=1.0. Mix proportions expressed per 1 m3 of concrete.
